title: When Love Becomes a Hangover You Can't Sleep Off | Intoxicated Senses (Original Poem)
description:
One day you're fine. The next, someone's laugh is living rent-free in your head, your morning coffee tastes different, and the part of your brain that's supposed to run the show has gone quiet. That's not a metaphor. That's what attachment actually does to the operating system.

This video pairs an original poem — Intoxicated Senses — with a reflection on what the poem is really about: the moment love stops feeling like a decision and starts feeling like physics. When the mind and heart stop cooperating and you're left without a ground to stand on or a sky to cover your head with.

Written and read by Tarun Gupta.
